* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Mitigating national security risks posed by Chinese AI entities bypassing advanced chip export controls through offshore infrastructure
* [Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core demand: Closing the regulatory loophole in cloud computing services to block Chinese access to high-performance AI hardware.

- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/56313c69a3bd467a
- Source: CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-china-cloud-ai-chip-access.html)
- Executive Summary: Nvidia has warned customers that the proposed Remote Access Security Act (RASA) would expand export controls to cloud-based GPU access, subjecting both providers and users to U.S. legal action for non-compliance. To mitigate regulatory risk, Nvidia has implemented a strict policy prohibiting clients from renting out more than 50% of their GPU capacity to Chinese entities.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Nvidia, U.S. House of Representatives, U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS): Implementation of RASA to regulate remote GPU access; capping Chinese entity rentals at 50% capacity
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Preventing circumvention of physical export controls via cloud-based remote access to maintain U.S. AI superiority
* [Key Metrics] Key details: Nvidia enforces a 50% rental cap; RASA, if enacted, grants the U.S. government direct enforcement authority over cloud services.
* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Cloud providers face heightened identity auditing; international compute supply chains are likely to see sustained cost increases.

- Executive Summary: Apple introduced stricter compliance requirements for Full Disk Access and Device Control APIs in the macOS 15.3 beta. - Key Verified Facts:

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Mitigate data leakage risks posed by AI agents over-requesting system-level permissions
* [Key Technical Spec] Core demand: Developers must adjust permission requests to prevent abuse of full disk access by AI agents.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Existing permissions remain, but new apps must prompt users for specific access to maintain security integrity.
